notes.title: Succubus Autumn Update
The Double Update is here!
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Players[/b],

Succubus has VERY POSITIVE reviews and is doing well, but it does not mean that our work is over. We are improving and expanding the game just like we have promised in our 2021 Roadmap.

Initially we have planned two separate, free updates, but we decided to combine them into one and give you everything at once. So here it is, the [b]Double Update for Succubus[/b]! 

[b]Here are the new features, options and fixes[/b]:

- New eyes (customization)
- New horns (customization)
- New bodypaintings - scarifications (customization)
- New ranked arenas
- Option to choose an alternate censorship mode (without medkits and pixelization)
- Postprocess effects from selfie mode can now be set in game too
- Bugfixes 

[b]And here are the sound fixes[/b]:

- Fixed the issue with women voices
- Jugs are no longer emitting improper sounds
- Audio balance tweaks
- Fixed the issue with bridge sounds not playing
- Fixed the issue with gate sounds not playing
- Fixed the issue with Pull Power sounds not working properly

[b]Enjoy![/b]
Madmind Studio

notes.title: SUCCUBUS Story Trailer and a new Release Date
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Players,[/b]

We come to you with the new trailer and to explain why we have decided to postpone the game until [b]October 5, 2021[/b]. The reason for postponing the release date is the need to fine-tune the game and bug fixing. To make sure that the you all get [b]a bug-free and well-optimized production[/b], we have decided to perform additional external tests and consulted the reviewers of well-known gaming services who completed the game and shared their thoughts and suggestions with us. We have decided to spend the extra time on [b]introducing a few improvements[/b] that will give the players a better and more satisfying production.

You always say that we need to take our time and that there is no rush and that is why [b]we have decided to take our time[/b]. There is no sense in releasing an unpolished product and we respect you too much to do so.

But we are not leaving you empty-handed. Here is our newest STORY TRAILER:

[previewyoutube=Uf39MT85kyM;full][/previewyoutube]

The key story cutscenes are created by talented animators from Fusion FX and Realtime Warriors, who have made, among others, cutscenes for The Witcher 3 and animations for Cyberpunk 2077. We hope you enjoy it and we appreciate your patience.

[b]Thank You,[/b]
Madmind Studio

notes.title: SUCCUBUS - NEW RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
[b]Hell(o),[/b]

We would like to inform you about the change of the release date of Succubus. Initially, the title was supposed to be released in July. However, we have decided to spend more time optimizing and refining the production.

[b]Succubus will be released on PC on September 8, 2021. [/b]

Thanks to [b]the extensive feedback from players[/b] who had the opportunity to check the game during the Steam Next demo festival, we have decided to refine some elements of the game so that our title can meet the high expectations of [b]you - our fans[/b]. We want to release a game with the quality of which we and the players will be satisfied, because [b]you, the players are most important[/b].

Succubus is getting more interest before its launch (based on Steam Wishlist) than our previous game Agony, which [b]sold over 500,000 copies[/b]. We believe that the extra time we have decided to spend on fine-tuning the title will allow us to provide fans with a production that meets their expectations.

The Succubus demo from the beginning to the end of the festival was the most popular and most downloaded demo in the genre of horror games. [b]We want to make it even better[/b]!

Please be patient, we are putting our hearts and souls into this project (plus Vydija is watching)!

[b]Your humble servants,[/b]
Madmind Studio

notes.title: Succubus Prologue patch#1 is live now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38368900/a0dc0d3ae101e60ca10c74777464d6692d749300.jpg[/img]
[b]Hell(o) Martyrs,[/b]

First of all - thank you for your feedback! 
We're delighted that you enjoy our new game. Thanks to you, we know what we should focus on right now.
Also, we are aware that the optimization might be a problem for some of you, that's why we will do what we can to improve that aspect of the game in the upcoming patches.

Today we're back with an extra pack of good news - [b]the first Succubus Prologue patch is now available for download![/b]

Below you will find a full list of changes in the [b]patch#1[/b]:

- Fixed torpedo on the ranked arena
- Reduced leaderboard query entries from 15 to 7 + player
- Fixed localization on pop-up - finisher
- Optimized spikes traps
- Fixed mouse sensitivity reset bug
- Fixed some bugged missions
- Fixed leaderboard display


[b]Have fun,[/b]
[i]Madminders[/i]
